t: You're standing at 48 Queen Anne Street, a building in Westminster, in the W1 postcode. Here, in 1876, the surgeon George Green Gascoyen died. He was forty-five, born in 1830, and worked as a general surgeon. That's about all the record tells us about this address, so it's best to take it as a quiet corner of the West End with one small piece of medical history attached, a Victorian surgeon whose life ended behind one of these doors.
